note: Rewritten from Sands' English original description of 1959 (new species Amitermes importunus sp. nov.); the original records the alate as Unknown. It describes the soldier and worker and gives measurement ranges and means, and this entry takes only the ranges. Distribution in the original (southern Africa to the Kalahari).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: New species (sp. nov.), alate unknown. Soldier head distinctly longer than wide in dorsal view, the sides from nearly parallel to clearly convergent anteriorly; mandibles slender, slightly longer than half the head, strongly hooked, the tooth at or slightly behind the middle; fore coxa without spines (only 1—2 hairs in the same position). From A. hastatus it differs in the less projecting mandibular tooth of the soldier and the different shape of the anterior lobe of the pronotum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, sometimes slightly darker in front and at the sides; mandibles pale brown to chestnut brown, yellowish brown at the base; antennae pale yellow; the rest yellowish white (the abdomen coloured by the gut contents showing through). Head distinctly longer than wide in dorsal view, the sides straight or convex, from nearly parallel to clearly convergent anteriorly; posterior margin regularly rounded, or with the posterior corners rounded and distinct. In profile the vertex nearly straight or weakly wavy between the slight swelling above the fontanelle and the sharper curve towards the occiput. Mandibles slender, slightly longer than half the head, strongly hooked; the tooth at or slightly behind the middle, projecting, upright, triangular to obliquely truncate, sometimes slightly rounded; the inner edge a regular arc from the base of the tooth to the apex, nearly straight near the apex. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 5 about equal in length and slightly longer than segment 4, segment 3 twice as long as segment 4. Head setae sparse. Anterior margin of the pronotum entire or weakly concave. Legs not distinctly setose, fore coxa without spines, only 1—2 hairs in the same position. Measurements: head length 1.04—1.61, greatest head width 0.90—1.16, mandible basal width 0.75—0.89, head thickness 0.77—1.00, left mandible length 0.68—0.86, pronotum length 0.32—0.43, width 0.61—0.75, hind tibia length 0.89—1.04.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body yellowish white; third marginal tooth of the left mandible usually projecting slightly beyond the cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth; the distance between the apex of the apical tooth and that of the first marginal tooth equal to or greater than the distance between the apices of the first and third marginal teeth.
